an3.15:2.1: The Sinhalese manuscript reading _pacetana_ should be preferred over Burmese _sacetana_. Sanskrit dictionaries note the term _pracetṛ_ (“charioteer”), which is evidently a misreading of _pravetṛ_ (see Patañjali Vyākaraṇamahābhāṣya: _rathasya pravetā_).
an3.15:2.4: This shows that a _ratha_ was two-wheeled, hence “chariot” rather than “wagon”. See too Śatapatha-brāhmaṇa 12.2.2.2.
